name: kopi
description: Evidence-led workflows for project managers and software architects.

interface.shortDescription: Run evidence-led project and architecture work.
interface.longDescription: Kopi connects technology research, architecture decisions, meetings, portfolio control, data analysis, and presentation creation through reviewable evidence and clear action ownership.
defaultPrompt: Turn my project evidence into an executive deck.
Prepare and schedule an architecture review.
Research recent framework changes and their impact.
